| CF-095 | WS-A2 §6.2 κ = (M, h, p, E, B, **seed**) and WS-B1 §5 ("matching across re-runs is by `configuration_id` + `seed`") vs provider-hosted models that may not honour sampling seeds and non-replayable control loops (ADR-0028) | A "seed" coordinate implies a control the instrument often lacks | Read `seed` as the **replicate axis**: `replicate_index` + recorded seed material (harness RNG seed, requested sampling seed, environment image digest); pairing across arms is by task, by replicate only where all participants declare `seed_honoured` (OQ-122). κ's shape is unchanged. |

Precedents recorded as *negative* in WS-I2 §4c. |

## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **replicate** | One independent run of a cell; carries `replicate_index` and *seed material* (harness RNG seed, requested sampling seed, environment image digest). The n in pass^k/pass@k is always a count of replicates, never of sub-units within one run. | WS-I2; reads κ's `seed` coordinate (CF-095). |
| **cell** | (arm, configuration, task); the unit that is replicated. | WS-I2 / WS-J3 |
| **design** | `Design{kind ∈ {paired, full_factorial, fractional_factorial, one_factor_at_a_time, adaptive_search}, factors, blocking, replicates_per_cell, pairing, seed_policy, held_out_split_ref, pre_registration}` — a first-class, content-addressed object. | WS-I2 / WS-J3 |
| **pre-registration record** | `{hypothesis, primary_metrics, equivalence_margin?, min_n, analysis_plan_ref, task_split_hash, registered_at}`; immutable once the experiment's first run opens; referenced by `measurement.experiment.bound`. | WS-I2 / WS-J3 / WS-I3 |
| **eval budget** / **search budget** / **search-budget record** | Per-run hard limits identical across compared arms / everything spent producing an arm's frozen artifact / `{rollouts, model_calls, tokens, feedback_labels_used, judge_calls, wall_clock, allocation, adaptive_selection?}`. | ADR-0046; refines T-LCD-14's fields. |
| **benefit kind** (artifact / search-time / transfer) | The three reportable rows of a comparison: frozen-artifact paired Δ on a held-out split; performance during search vs an equal-search-budget baseline; paired Δ on a held-out model family/environment/task family (with `transfer_ratio`). | ADR-0046; ADR-0002 evidence standard. |
| **budget-match status** | `{matched, imbalanced, unmatched}`: limits equal and consumption within tolerance / limits equal, consumption beyond tolerance (reported with cost-adjusted view) / limits unequal (refused). | ADR-0046 |
| **outcome class** | `{scored, budget_exhausted, infrastructure_failure, oracle_failure, refused, cancelled}` derived per run from ledger facts; each metric declares an `outcome_class_policy`. | ADR-0045 |
| **`n/a{reason}`** | Typed non-value with `reason ∈ {class, observability, estimator_undefined, not_run, no_detector}`; never rendered as 0 or a proxy. Extends the ratified "n/a, never 0". | ADR-0045; T-LCD-15 |
| **oracle class** / **oracle declaration** | `{executable, end_state, output_check, trace_predicate, protocol_check, judge, human, teacher_relative, reference_relative}`; `OracleDeclaration{class, deterministic, requires_observability, verdict_type, evidence_out, cost_attribution, calibration_ref?, provenance}`. | ADR-0047; judge = WS-A3 `Validator{kind: judge}`. |
| **headline metric** / **judged metric** | A metric eligible for the top-line capability number (deterministic oracle classes only at C0) / a metric whose values carry `detector = judged` and are reported under their own name. | ADR-0047 |
| **veto invariant** / **success-with-veto** | A `veto: true` metric whose failure invalidates nominal success (secret leak, duplicate effect, authority widening, out-of-scope irreversible effect, inconsistent durable state, revoked-policy action) / the reporting state of a run that succeeded on the task but tripped a veto — excluded from headline success, counted beside it. | ADR-0047; generalizes AgentDojo utility/security. |
| **pass^k** / **pass@k** | E_task[C(c,k)/C(n,k)] (all k attempts succeed) / 1 − C(n−c,k)/C(n,k) (at least one succeeds); n = replicates; `n/a{estimator_undefined}` for k > n. | S-127, S-235; tau-bench/Inspect source. |
| **interval method** | `{clt, clustered_clt(task), wilson, bootstrap, bayesian_beta}` declared per metric; clustered-by-task is the default for task-level binary metrics. | S-234; Inspect `std.py`. |
| **tail statistic** / **catastrophic-failure rate** | P95/P99/max over runs of cost, wall-clock or severity / fraction of runs classified at the top severity tier (taxonomy owner OQ-125). | HAL `error_classifier` precedent. |
| **fault profile** / **perturbation profile** | Levels of the environment factor that inject API/tool faults (HAL `FaultType`) or structurally perturb tool surfaces/response formats (HAL `R_struct`); feed reliability and portability metrics. | WS-I2 / WS-I4 / WS-B5 |
| **scorecard dimension** / **scorecard row** / **scorecard report** | A tag on a `MetricDeclaration` (eight doc 2 §8 dimensions + compliance) / one configuration's summaries across all registry metrics / the persisted report `{rows, comparisons, generated_from, metric_registry_version, price_table_version}`. | WS-I2 / WS-J4 / WS-J5 |
| **comparison report** | `{arm_a, arm_b, metric, pairing, paired_effect{point, interval, method}, per_task_effects_ref, budget_match, benefit_kind, held_out, estimated?}`; the only admissible form of "A beats B". | ADR-0046 |
| **equivalence margin** | The pre-registered per-dimension margin for `equivalence_run` (T-LCD-03/-04); verdict `{equivalent, not_equivalent, inconclusive}`. | WS-I2 / LCD battery; OQ-126 |
| **teacher-relative lift** | Oracle class scoring a learning harness by the convergence of its student toward a stronger teacher's sparse corrections (S-068); calibrated, C4-only, `provisional`. | ADR-0047 |
| **dynamic opacity** (`opacity_dynamic`) | Per-model-call distribution of untyped-text tokens ÷ context tokens from `context.assembled`; reported beside WS-A3's static `opacity_ratio`. | WS-I2; CF-100; OQ-036 |
